introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under butt and your hands under shoulders. \n\nThen lift your right leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: DONKEY KICKS RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
To get better results, keep your core tight.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your gluteus, and can also work on your hamstrings.

introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.
name: BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your left leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: DONKEY KICKS LEFT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.

Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your right leg to the side at a 90 degree angle.
name: FIRE HYDRANT RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your arms straight.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
Always keep your core tight.
Don't arch your back.
Don't lift your leg higher than your torso.
Lift your leg as you exhale and lower it as you inhale.
If it's too easy for you, hold your leg up for several seconds.
You should feel your butt burning.
This exercise tones and firms up your butt and thighs.
This exercise can strengthen your hips and tighten your core.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your left leg to the side at a 90 degree angle.
name: FIRE HYDRANT LEFT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.

introduce: Lie down on your side with your head rested on your left arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.\n\nMake sure your right leg goes straight up and down during the exercise. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

introduce:

Make sure your left leg goes straight up and down during the exercise.

It's a great exercise for the gluteus.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Then lift one leg up while raising your hips off the floor as high as you can. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: HIP BRIDGE & LEG LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your spine straight when lifting your hips.
Tighten your abdominals.
Don't bend your lifted leg.
Exhale when lifting your hips, and inhale when lowering them.
If you feel it's too easy, don't make your hips touch the floor.
If you feel it's too hard, put both feet on the floor.
You shouldn't feel stress in your back, neck and shoulder area.
This exercise not only works on your glutes, but also your abs and hamstrings.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Then lift one leg up while raising your hips off the floor as high as you can. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat with the other side.
name: HIP BRIDGE & LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your spine straight when lifting your hips.
Tighten your abdominals.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees up at a 90 degree angle and your arms lifted towards the ceiling. 

Lower your right leg, and extend your left arm above your head. 

Hold it for one second, then return to the start position and repeat with the other side.
name: DEAD BUG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please always keep your lower back pressed against the floor.
Please don\'t arch your back.
Too hard? Just extend your arms or legs.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale when lifting your arm and opposite leg, and exhale when lowering them.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your right knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your left knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the ground hip-width apart and your arms straight by your sides. \n\nLift your hips up off the ground into a butt bridge position. Lift one knee up towards your chest, and then lower it back without dropping your hips. Switch sides, and repeat the exercise.
name: MARCHING HIP RAISES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Make sure your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Squeeze your glutes as you lift your hips.
Please don\'t tuck your chin.
Exhale through your mouth as you raise one leg off the ground.
Inhale through your nose as you lower the leg down.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs extended and your arms by your sides. 

As you inhale, lift your head, chest, arms, and legs off the ground, firming your shoulder blades onto your back. Imagine someone grasping your hands, gently pulling you back, to come up higher.

Hold this position. Use the inhale to support the lift of your head, chest, arms, and legs.
name: LOCUST POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your pubic bone on the floor when lifting your legs.
Inhale to lift higher. Exhale to release your tension.
This exercise tones your buttocks and strengthens your back muscles.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with legs straight and squeezed together, interlock fingers behind your back, and rest your face on one cheek.

Exhale and bend both legs, pulsing your feet toward your buttocks for three pulses.

Inhale and lift your upper back, open your shoulders and straighten your arms and legs behind you. 

Lower your body and repeat on the other side.
name: DOUBLE LEG KICK

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your belly flat on the mat.
Please do not strain your neck.
This exercise can stabilize your core muscles.
This exercise well strengthens the muscles of your back, glutes, hamstrings, and shoulders.
Exhale as you bend both legs and pulse your feet towards your buttocks.
Inhale as you lift your upper back and open your shoulders.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.

Engage your core and press your feet into the floor, lifting your hips off the ground to form a bridge position.

Pulse your hips up and down in a small range of motion.

Repeat the exercise.
name: GLUTE BRIDGE PULSE

tips.text: Keep your shoulders and upper back grounded on the mat.
Please squeeze your glutes and keep your core stable.
This exercise targets your hip muscles.
This exercise helps build lower body strength.
Exhale as you lift your hips into the bridge position.
Inhale as you lower your hips slightly.

introduce:
Lie on your right side with your right hand supporting your body, right knee bent on the floor, and your left leg lifted parallel to the floor. 

Put your left hand behind your head.

Move your left leg forward and backward and repeat.
name: KNEELING SIDE KICK LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please tighten your core.
Breathe naturally.
Please put your right hand directly under your shoulder.
Please put your hip right over your right knee.
This exercise can strengthen your glutes.

introduce:

Move your right leg forward and backward and repeat.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
